## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (56%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (37%) is in the 90% prediction set [F1], with superior and lateral margins flagged [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 56%, InSitu 37%, Invasive 6%, Normal 1% | Split between Benign and InSitu |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100% OOD (12/12 regions) [F6] | Atypical image, no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models share top call |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign, 3/5 InSitu (40%) [F5] | Neighbors favor InSitu (top 90%) |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score lowers invasive risk [F2] (AI spot check 12/20) · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable (0/20 AI spot check); low score raises invasive risk [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score raises invasive risk [F4] (AI spot check 20/20) · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · High score lowers invasive risk; differs from InSitu match BACH_0179 · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below-average infiltration score lowers invasive risk (AI spot check 19/20) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (95% CI [0.0021, 0.0197] excludes 0), confirming classifier faithfulness.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI [-0.0088, 0.0064] includes 0 (unproven faithfulness); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Intraductal atypia is InSitu carcinoma (37% probability; 3/5 neighbors, including 90%-similar BACH_0179, are InSitu).
- Deeper levels reveal unsampled atypia or invasion (order drafted; stains blocked on simulated frozen sections).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 2**: Inspect highest heatmap-risk regions (48%, 22%, 12%) for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 5, 6, 7**: Evaluate intraductal atypia for Benign vs InSitu; consider drafted deeper levels.
3. **Regions 1, 3**: Check superior and lateral margins for lesion involvement (215 um each, 100% score).
